notes: N1 [H1 / HEADLINE] "RETIRE THE CLICKER" is clear but names no pain: at thumbnail it reads as a neutral product category, not the A1 office moment (Q21), and does not set up the silent payoff -> add the pain word. Kept in chiefed v1. Example fix: "RETIRE THE / LOUD CLICKER" (10 and 11 chars, 4 words, still command + negative framing, attacks the object not its users).

N2 [SUBHEAD] draft subhead carries the dhikr identity but is generic ('Get a ring that counts...') and 10 words pushes total on-image words to 25 when hyphens are split -> shorten, identity-label the reader with 'your dhikr'. Example fix: "Count your dhikr with one silent tap." (A-1, A-11; kept in chiefed v1).

N3 [Primary text, objection line] "Worried it will stop working after a month?" plants doubt about OUR ring -> aim the fear at cheap counters (Q11), then give the guarantee. Example fix: "Tried a cheap counter that quit after a month? You get a 60-day money-back guarantee and a 1-year tech warranty." (kept in chiefed v1).

N4 [Meta headline 1 / CTA line] keep the 'loud' word consistent with the on-image headline and stay <=40 chars. Example fix: "Retire the loud clicker. Keep dhikr." (36); CTA line "Tap Shop Now and retire the loud clicker." (kept in chiefed v1).
N5 [Round 2 check] copywriter must confirm no clicker/bead insult and no finger-counting mention remain; the seal, offer bar, H2-H5 and the bead line are fine and should not change.
